author: Ifmyante
text:
We know that price can often get stuck in ranges, and in ranges, highs and lows can inexplicably be broken.

So we must ask ourselves "In this range, what are the limits?" So we look for the FLs, and don't expect zones inside them to be as strong as the FLs themselves

author: ttfreitas
text:
AERO wrote: Picture would be great haha. - I was thinking: I must have sold too cheap still... The big money idea is probably getting to the upper engulf and compressing its way - since then they get a bigger R:R.

Hello, AERO I hope your trade works out the way you planned.

I did notice the compression as well, but below I explain my reasons for not entering.

In the 4 hour chart, I see a couple of supply areas above the current price level. Like IF mentioned in an earlier post, beware of stacked supply. Price often goes all the way before making a decision.

I don't see an engulf of the flag level in the 1H chart. To me, this means that price is not planning to move south.

Finally, if I were to sell this pair, I would have waited for the level highlighted in the 5min chart because that's where I see an important decision point. See how price sprung from that level. Such level also coincides with the QM level that you mentioned.

Anyway, I sincerely hope the trade goes your way. Let me know what you think of this analysis. Cheers
